description: Hermes Knowledge OS v2 maintenance jobs — staged enablement. Lint-only until Phase C critical-clean.

jobs.prompt: Knowledge OS lint (read-only): Run `python scripts/knowledge_os_lint.py` against Growth OS (Mac path or VPS /opt/hermes/data/obsidian/Growth OS). Summarize CRITICAL/WARN counts. Do not merge, ingest, archive, promote, or rewrite pages. If CRITICAL>0, list paths and stop.

Knowledge OS daily (enable only after Phase C critical-clean): Load wiki-daily; orient on hot.md + indexes only. List unprocessed raw/ from last 48h. Compile with wiki-ingest to status ≤ CONNECTED. Append compile-log. Do not set CANONICAL.

Knowledge OS nightly (enable only after Phase C critical-clean): Run wiki-lint. Auto-fix only safe issues (index rows, missing DRAFT frontmatter). Write report under workspace/drafts/. Propose merges; do not CANONICAL or delete raw/.

Knowledge OS weekly (enable only after Phase C critical-clean): Orient; lint; list CONNECTED/VERIFIED promote candidates; create packages under workspace/promotions/ via wiki-promote but do not apply without Dylan.
Knowledge OS monthly (enable only after Phase C critical-clean): Lint then propose archive/ontology updates. No raw deletes. No CANONICAL edits.
